name: starflask_convert_video
description: Convert / transcode a video to another format via Starflask (ffmpeg). The headline use: turn an mp4 into an ANIMATED WEBP (target_format "webp", the default) or an animated GIF; also re-encodes to mp4 or webm. Returns a job id immediately — poll with starflask_get_job until status is 'completed', then read result.video_url (the converted file, e.g. the animated .webp). `video_url` must be a video URL Starflask can fetch — from starflask_upload_media or a prior job's result.video_url. (Sends job type video:convert with model ffmpeg-convert for you.)

video_url.description: URL of the source video to convert (from starflask_upload_media or a prior job's result.video_url).

target_format.description: Output format. "webp" = animated WebP (default), "gif" = animated GIF, "mp4" = re-encoded MP4, "webm" = WebM.

max_width.description: Optional max output width in pixels; the video is scaled down to fit (default 640).

start_time.description: Optional start offset in seconds to trim from (default 0).

duration.description: Optional number of seconds to keep, starting at start_time (default: to the end).
